Кругляши покупок и продаж на линии цены:: Buy and sell bubbles on the price line: the levels at which funds built their position and where they exited. Bubble size is the net trade amount for the month.
Сколько рублей выбранные фонды держат в: How many rubles the selected funds hold in the security: the security's share in the fund's portfolio multiplied by its NAV, summed across funds. The absolute size of the bet.
Позиция фондов в процентах от free-float: Fund position as a percentage of the company's free-float market cap — the value of shares in free circulation. Calculated from the MOEX Broad Market Index constituents data: the security's market cap on the date × the exchange's official free-float coefficient, with the historical share count — secondary offerings and buybacks are accounted for. Available only for stocks in the Broad Market Index.

Бумаги, которых стало больше. Под назван: Securities whose position grew. Below the name — by how many units the position increased and its current share.

Смотреть лучше на совпадения между фонда: It is best to look for agreement between funds:
Много фондов дружно докупают одну бумагу: Many funds are adding the same security together
Управляющие сошлись на одной бумаге — эт: Managers have converged on one security — this can be read as interest in it, but not as a guarantee of growth.
Много фондов сокращают одну бумагу: Many funds are reducing the same security
Несколько фондов уменьшают позицию. Иног: Several funds are cutting their position. Sometimes this is due to index rebalancing or a reassessment of the company's prospects.
Новая позиция сразу в нескольких фондах: A new position in several funds at once
Бумага только появилась в портфелях — во: The security has just appeared in portfolios — possibly a new index inclusion or a fresh idea from the managers.
Концентрированный фонд — судьба зависит: A concentrated fund — its fate depends on a handful of securities. More upside, but also more risk if a single security drops.
Состав почти повторяет индекс МосБиржи: Holdings almost replicate the MOEX Index
Это индексный фонд — движения в основном: This is an index fund — its moves mostly reflect index rebalancing, not active selection.
Состав сильно отличается от индекса: Holdings differ strongly from the index
Это авторский фонд — управляющий ставит: This is an actively managed fund — the manager bets on their own selection. Their buys and sells carry more information about their view of the market.
Приток денег в бумагу растёт месяц за ме: Money inflow into a security grows month after month
Разовый всплеск может быть просто ребала: A one-off spike may be just rebalancing, while several months in a row sometimes add up to a more persistent picture.
